description: Recover an organization-owned immutable acquisition receipt, exact raw/transformed file descriptors, bounded source text and an expiring archive link. Retain the bundle digest and distinguish original upstream bytes, installer transformations and later CueFrame adaptations. Binary/large files are explicitly identified; omitted text is not empty source. Foreign live references refuse. Saved provenance supports owned forks; it never grants compatibility, ownership of another organization’s objects, or a fresh rendered preview.
